# 0.9 preview assets

- **City Kit (Commercial), 2.1** — Kenney, CC0 1.0. https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-commercial
  Original license is included at `kenney-city/License.txt`. GLB models and their texture are unmodified.
- **Metal Plate 02** — Rob Tuytel / Poly Haven, CC0. https://polyhaven.com/a/metal_plate_02
  1K diffuse, OpenGL normal and roughness maps. Used for tabletop and card foil materials.
- **Studio Small 06** — Greg Zaal / Poly Haven, CC0. https://polyhaven.com/a/studio_small_06
  1K HDR environment, used for ambient lighting and material reflections.

Poly Haven asset license: https://polyhaven.com/license
CC0 text: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Retrieved 2026-10-04. Card illustrations and faction images remain player-authored assets.

- **Lucide icons** — Lucide contributors, ISC license (Feather-derived icons retain their MIT notice). https://lucide.dev/ . SVG stroke color adapted for this UI; original license included in `lucide/LICENSE`.
